visualReview.result: No blocking layout issue observed. Branding, hero CTAs, mobile menu and booking/contact forms are readable; narrow portrait controls fit. Landscape contact content continues through the dialog scroll area above the fixed action footer. No booking was submitted.
visualReview.introScope: Main audit uses reduced-motion for complete site flows and explicit skip in its separate normal-motion scenario; full scroll intro audit is owned separately.
